decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already captures removal of the purple-marked walls and leaving the counter side open; refrigerator placement requires no partition-state change.
The corridor design request is an independent clause already represented by its same-message INTRODUCE Event; the kitchen changes do not further alter it.
Removing kitchen-side walls, leaving the counter side open, and adding refrigerators do not change Unit 3 bathroom geometry or fixtures.
The kitchen layout changes do not alter the requirement to show room dimensions.
